Name: Jagmohan Keshari
Question: When does Elena get together with Damon in The Vampire Diaries?
Answer: The answer to this question wouldn’t be justified by just mentioning the episode name or something like that. The answer to this question requires a bit of explanation. This is a very complex question which has been asked over and over again. Everywhere. Many people just don't seem to grasp Elena's swing towards Damon - especially when she was already in a relationship with Stefan. She did not get together with Damon in a straight line. It took years to build-up her feelings for him. Till the point, she dumped Stefan and immediately caught up with Damon. Well, please allow me to explain those little steps she took, even though unknowingly, which took her closer to Damon. Remember in season 1 when Damon was in full swing mode to open the tomb that he thought Katherine was in? He loved Katherine for more than 145 years. He waited for her all those years. At first, Elena and Stefan cheated him, by tricking him to believe that they were helping him in opening the tomb. But in the second attempt, Elena removed her vervain necklace and talked with Damon so that he would trust her. He could have compelled her at that time, but he didn't. That was the very first event where she developed a little softer side towards him. Even though she didn't realize that at that time. Elena’s nature was very different from other girls. She saw the good in people. She had sympathy for people too. She never abandoned the people whom she cared about. She was even willing to sacrifice herself for the people she cared about. She almost did that a few times. I believe somewhere deep down in her heart, she had sympathy for Damon - because his love for Katherine was very strong (she could empathize with that), and also because he was Stefan’s brother. Well, as the story moves on, Damon found that Katherine wasn’t inside the tomb. He was very hurt because of this. Elena could feel what he was going through. She came towards him to share his pain. She also hugged him to ease his pain from Katherine’s betrayal (or sort of betrayal) and to show that she cared about him. Afterwards, when Stefan was taken away by the tomb vampires, she accompanied Damon into saving him along with Alaric. She didn’t know at the time, but slowly her softness towards Damon was beginning to take deeper roots in her heart. And remember the beauty contest episode? Elena had been rehearsing her dance steps with Stefan, but he didn’t show up at the event. Then Damon, without any previous plans or practice, stepped up and became her partner in the dance scene. I’d like to think that he did much, much better job - in dancing with her with perfect positioning and steps. Also, he saved her from the embarrassment in front of the whole crowd because her original dance partner Stefan didn’t show up at the event. This is where she began to like him much more. Everything was slowly developing until Katherine showed up and broke his heart. Again. In the same episode, Elena broke his heart too. There's so much pain a man can take. Then, he spiralled and snapped Elena's brother’s neck (but he was wearing the Gilbert ring, so he came back). Afterwards, he was honest when she asked him whether he knew about the ring. Afterwards, the episode where Elena, Damon and Alaric went to meet Isobel’s intern, he took an arrow behind his back to save Elena. See, these little or big things Damon did for her, kept magnifying her feelings for him. After that, in one episode, Isobel tells her that Damon is in love with her. Remember? The whole of season 2 showed Damon’s attempts to save Elena. He also once told Stefan that he would let her hate him, but he would be the one keeping her alive. The vervain necklace (which was a symbol of her and Stefan's love) played an important role too. After she was kidnapped by Rose, Damon found it and gave it back to her. Selflessly. After that, the much of the season 3 revolved around Damon helping Elena get Stefan back. But Stefan did some weird things (crazy Stefan) that pushed her away from him and slowly closer to Damon. Also, we again saw that the vervain necklace had a key role to play. Damon gave it back to her on her birthday. Again. In season 4, after she transitioned into a vampire, her feelings for Damon were magnified to a much larger scale. He also fished her daylight ring out and returned it to her. That, after he saved her. Again. Her feelings for Damon had become so strong that she broke up with Stefan and immediately went into Damon’s arms. She was sired to Damon, yes, but still, her feelings for him were much stronger than anything she had ever felt in her life. And at the end of the season, Elena (without being sired) confessed her love to Damon. And from there, they never looked back. That is when they got together. In season 5, we saw a few breakups and similar stuff, but they were never really separated from each other. They were always together. Damon even told her, “Being with you drives me nuts. Not being with you drives me nuts." Thank you for reading this answer. I wrote down what I felt from my perspective. It became a bit lengthy answer, but I believe this topic needed this kind of explanation. Thank you. Image credit: The CW Network.

Question: Is Sansa Stark the best written character on GOT?
Answer: Yes, you could say that. “My skin has turned to porcelain, to ivory, to steel.” This Sansa quote perfectly captures her development of a thicker skin throughout the series. Out of all the Stark siblings still around, Sansa is the only one who hasn't had any supernatural or otherworldly help to get to where she is. She hasn't developed special abilities like seeing into the past and future, been trained by mysterious assassins, or been brought back to life by a powerful deity. Sansa is a regular person in a chaotic world, using her intelligence and the support of other ordinary people to survive. This makes her able to relate with people in a way that Jon, Arya, and Bran cannot. She is practical, down-to-earth, and strong in her own way. Her growth over the seasons has been admirable because she doesn't have magical powers or dragons to rely on. She has to be clever enough to figure out what and who will help her. Even when her sister is disturbing her with talk of taking faces and making threats, Sansa does her research and collaborates with Bran and Arya to outmanoeuvre Littlefinger after his attempts to divide the siblings. I really love Sansa and Jon's relationship. Their reunion scene is my favourite in the series. They both went through some tough times, especially Sansa. It's the first time two Starks were reunited, and the emotions were really powerful. My favourite part of their relationship is when Sansa warns Jon about a danger, but he doesn't listen, and then she has to save him. She goes through a really hard time to save him and bring him home. Speaking of her bonding with Jon, the immediate threat at the time was Ramsay Bolton. Jon wasn’t really prepared for the battle but went out anyway. It’s only because of Sansa’s brilliance (in bringing the army of the Vale) that the psychotic Ramsay was defeated. Fans had been waiting for a long time to see what would become of Ramsay - and our Queen in the North fittingly had him executed by his own dogs, which was like a poetic justice. This relationship goes through a big change. At first, Arya and Sansa really didn't like each other. But later, they become great allies, supporting each other and working together. It was nice to see Arya standing up for Sansa and helping her talk sense into Jon. Throughout the series, Sansa wears a necklace that represents her bond with Arya, who has a similar one. The necklaces show their determination to fight. She was never power-hungry. She never wanted to rule the entire Westeros like so many power-hungry queens. It’s just that she wanted the safety and security of her native North. The scene where she asked Jon who will look after the North when he was about to sail for Dragonstone, that scene tells us that she never saw herself to be the queen - but Jon gave his position to her anyway. Another scene which shows us how much she cared for her native Northmen is when she wanted to hold the fort before the Battle of Winterfell, but her little sister Arya told her that she was too prominent to be on the battlefield and that she should stay back underground. Sansa has zero fighting skills, but still she wanted to be out there on the battlefield. That’s a lot of courage for her. The scene where she had the master manipulator Petyr Baelish executed for his crimes was awesome. She was manipulated by him throughout the series, but by learning his game, she finally defeats the chess player. She's even more formidable than he is. She's been a slow learner, but she learns, and she has learned to become the most powerful person in the game because she knows the game better than anyone else.

Question: What is the salary of each actor on "Friends" per episode? How did they negotiate their salaries for future episodes while filming the current ones?
Answer: In its first season, the main cast of Friends earned $22,500 per episode, totalling about $540,000 for the season. Lisa Kudrow, Matt LeBlanc, Matthew Perry, and Courteney Cox continued to earn the same rate in the following seasons, while Jennifer Aniston and David Schwimmer had their pay increased to $40,000 per episode due to their popularity. In the third season, the entire cast collectively bargained and secured a raise to $75,000 per episode. The fourth season saw another raise to $85,000 per episode, and in the fifth season, they were earning $100,000 per episode, totalling $2.4 million per season. For the sixth season, they negotiated a raise to $125,000 per episode, and by season seven, each member earned more than $36 million for seasons seven and eight combined. In the ninth and tenth seasons, each main cast member earned $1 million per episode, or $1.68 million when adjusted for inflation. Overall, the cast collectively earned more than $100 million in salaries over the show's 10-year run. Additionally, they each earned $20 million from residuals and syndication of the show, bringing their total earnings from Friends to astronomical figures. Warner Bros. has earned $1 billion from the show, and the cast members are still receiving checks from residuals and syndication. Remember what Chandler said in the very first episode? That is, “I just want a million dollars!” And so, his wish was granted. Lol. Image credit: Friends, NBC.
